chunks: Whatever is in Hā from Saʿīd al-Aʿraj, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazanṭī, from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr al-Khathʿamī, from Saʿīd ibn ʿAbd Allah al-Aʿraj al-Kūfī.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate transmitter in this chain.
key_terms.الْأَعْرَجِ: Al-Aʿraj; the narrator to whom this transmission path leads.
key_terms.الْبَزَنْطِيِّ: Al-Bazanṭī; a well-known narrator designation in the chain.
key_terms.الْخَثْعَمِيِّ: Al-Khathʿamī; the tribal attribution of one narrator in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an expression indicating narration through a sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Saʿīd al-Aʿraj in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a chain clarification from Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the sanad/isnad through which al-Shaykh transmits reports from Saʿīd al-Aʿraj. Its significance lies in hadith documentation, preserving the route of transmission through named narrators back to Saʿīd al-Aʿraj al-Kūfī.
